title: Flow Node Element Border and Hover
description: Flow canvas nodes use emphasized border by default and lack hover effect. Fix pointer hover tracking and ensure Vello node stroke defaults to element gray.
summary: Fixed flow node hover: `onPointerMove` now calls `pointerMoveScreen` on idle cursor movement (not only during active drag), and `onPointerLeave` clears hover. Updated Vello theme tokens so node/label defaults use element gray (`labelFill` → element, `labelFillHovered` → emphasized). Aligned puzzle2d default node/handle stroke styles to element. Added `idle_pointer_move_updates_hover` dag test confirming hit-test hover updates.
